legacy-of-goku-2.notes: Legacy of Goku II (USA). Each slot's four direction words each name a terminated run of bare piece records; the run is a piece pool, so its length is not a published-frame count.

imports.notes: Owner-approved treatment, 2026-11-07: LOG1 art 47 reuses the art 46 donor art (option 1 of the three reviewed) and waits for a custom art 47 sprite. Every animation is ADAPTED because these donor frames are being carried into a slot the donor does not own; nothing here is drawn, recoloured or invented. A donor search for armoured Krillin art was closed with no candidate in either donor image.

palette.provenance: NOT DECIDED, and inherited from the art 46 reuse. Twenty-two distinct non-zero donor indices are used by the carried groups against a fifteen-index LOG1 bank.

swap_in.source: the art 46 import of this donor definition, reusing its art unchanged; the slot is declared so an owner-supplied custom art 47 sprite replaces it without changing any other manifest
